What is Funnelish and how does it work?

Funnelish is an all-in-one platform with high-converting funnel and blog builder, designed specifically for e-commerce. It allows you to create high-speed, mobile-optimized landing pages, custom checkouts, post-purchase upsell flows, blogs and more. It works either as a standalone platform or as a powerful extension of your Shopify store, syncing orders and tracking information automatically.

Learn more

E-Commerce Funnels & High-Converting Checkouts

Funnelish v2: More Than Funnels - A Complete All-in-one eCommerce Platform

Does Funnelish have any tools for AOV and CVR optimization?

Yes, optimization is the core of Funnelish. The platform includes built-in tools proven to increase Average Order Value (AOV) and Conversion Rate (CVR), such as:

  • True One-Click Upsells: Offer additional products after the initial purchase.

  • Order Bumps: Add-on offers directly on the checkout page.

  • Native A/B Testing: Easily test headlines, pricing, and layouts.

  • Speed Optimization: Lightning-fast page loads that prevent bounce rates.

Learn more

7 Ways to Boost Your Store with Funnelish

Why Funnel Checkout Pages Outperform Shopify's Cart Checkout

Can I build a D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) business with Funnelish?

Absolutely. Funnelish is the first funnel builder specifically architected for the D2C business model. It gives brands full control over the customer experience and data, allowing you to bypass third-party marketplaces and build direct relationships with your buyers through integrated SMS, email, and high-performance storefronts.

Learn more

The Ultimate Guide to DTC E-commerce: Launch, Scale, and Own Your Brand

What are sales funnels?

A sales funnel is a strategic, step-by-step journey designed to guide a potential customer from their first interaction with your brand to a final purchase. It focuses the user on one specific offer at a time, significantly increasing conversion rates compared to traditional websites.

Learn more

One-Product Funnel: How to Build One That Turns Strangers into Loyal Customers (2026 Guide)

Sales Funnel Software: 7 Tools Compared (And Why Funnelish Wins for Ecommerce)

What is dropshipping and is it legal?

Dropshipping is a fulfillment model where you sell products without holding inventory; the supplier ships directly to the customer. It is 100% legal and widely used, provided you comply with local tax laws and consumer protection regulations.

Learn more

How to Start Dropshipping Business in 2026: Practical Guide

Is Dropshipping Legal in 2026? A Complete US Compliance Guide

How can I use sales funnels to scale my dropshipping business?

Sales funnels are a "cheat code" for dropshippers because they allow you to maximize the value of every visitor. By using Funnelish, you can implement sophisticated upsell flows that make you profitable even when advertising costs rise on platforms like Meta or Google.

Learn more

Dropshipping Sales Funnel Builder to Scale Faster

How can I earn with sales funnels in 2026?

The 2026 market rewards speed and localization. By using Funnelish to create ultra-fast mobile experiences and localized checkouts for global audiences, you can build a highly profitable digital brand with higher margins than traditional e-commerce stores.

Learn more

The Complete Guide to eCommerce Funnels: From Awareness to Conversion (and Beyond)

Can I use Funnelish with Shopify?

Yes! Funnelish offers a deep, native integration with Shopify. You can use Funnelish to handle the "front-end" (the fast-loading pages and high-converting checkout) while Shopify handles your "back-end" (inventory and order management). Orders placed in Funnelish are pushed to Shopify in real-time.

Learn more

Shopify orders sync

Connect Your Shopify Store

If I switch to Funnelish, how can I transfer my data over?

We can do it for you - our team can clone your funnel into Funnelish for free. You will find the “Build a funnel for me” option in your account in Funnelish app.

Learn more

Funnelish plans

Which payment methods does Funnelish support?

Funnelish supports over 21+ popular payment methods through its native "Funnelish Pay" app. This includes Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, NMI, iDEAL, Bancontact, and even Cash on Delivery (COD).

Learn more

Add payment methods - Funnelish Docs

Can I use my own domain name with Funnelish?

Yes. You can connect your own custom domains (e.g., www.yourbrand.com) to any funnel you build. This ensures your brand identity remains consistent and professional.

How much does Funnelish cost?

Funnelish offers three main tiers to grow with your business:

  • Basic ($49/mo) : Up to 20 funnels and 20k visitors.

  • Pro ($79/mo) : Up to 100 funnels and 100k visitors.

  • Advanced ($249/mo): Unlimited funnels and high-volume traffic support.

All plans come with a 14-day free trial.

Funnelish Pricing & Plans

Does Funnelish charge any transaction fees?

No. Funnelish has 0% commission fees. Unlike other platforms that take a percentage of your sales, Funnelish charges a flat monthly subscription. What you earn is yours to keep.

Do I need to pay extra for the Upsell pages or Blog builder?

No. Features like True One-Click Upsells and the Blog/Content Builder are included natively in your subscription. There are no "hidden app fees" or extra costs for these essential scaling tools.

Learn more

Build your Blog with Funnelish

Funnelish page builder

In what countries can I use Funnelish?

Funnelish is a global platform. It is particularly powerful for international sellers because of its Geo-Funnels feature, which automatically detects a visitor's location and adjusts the currency, language, and payment options to match their local market.

How can I become a Funnelish Affiliate?

To become an affiliate, log in to your Funnelish account, click on your profile avatar, and select "Become an Affiliate." You can earn recurring commissions by referring other entrepreneurs to the platform.
